fields.description: From an MGA or FMO partner. Leave blank if you don't have one.

fields.label: Agency principal
fields.content:
Agency principal

The owner or person authorized to enroll the agency. You'll manage your agency's membership.

fields.label: Email address
fields.description: This will be your agency admin login email.

fields.label: About how many people?
fields.description: A starting point. Your price adjusts to the people you add.

fields.label: What happens next
fields.content:
What happens next

  1. Add your agency details and your NPN.
  2. Add your people, one at a time or by spreadsheet. Your rate updates as you go.
  3. Review and pay by card or bank. Everyone gets an email invitation to set up their account.
[properx_pricing view="apply-tiers"]

You'll continue in the secure member portal. Your progress is saved, so you can finish later.

fields.description: As printed on your resident insurance license. We use it to verify your license is active.

fields.label: NPN (National Producer Number) (optional)
fields.description: The number NIPR assigned to your insurance license, 7 to 10 digits, if you have it.

fields.label: Resident License Number
fields.description: In order to validate your NPN, we need your resident license number.

inputs.label: State / Province
inputs.customLabel: The state where your primary insurance license is held.

fields.label: Insurance license expiration date
fields.description: Your license must be current and active. Expired licenses are not eligible for membership.

fields.label: Copy of your license
fields.description: A photo or scan of your current resident insurance license: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB. It speeds up the verification of your license.

fields.label: Payment
fields.description: The 2.9% surcharge applies to credit cards only. Debit cards and bank payments have no surcharge.

fields.label: ACH Payment Notice
fields.content:
ACH Direct Debit Information

When paying via ACH Direct Debit, your bank transaction may take 3 to 5 business days to clear.
Your membership application will remain in Pending status until Stripe confirms the successful transfer.

fields.label: Payment Information
fields.description: Your payment is processed securely. Card information is never stored on our servers.

Individual membership, 1 year
Credit card surcharge (2.9%)
Total today
